insight: OpenAI Startup Fund led its $14M round in 2025 after Endex built an autonomous financial analyst on o1 as an early design partner.
name: Endex
tagline: AI financial analyst agent built natively into Excel.
description: Endex embeds an AI agent natively into Microsoft Excel for institutional finance teams. It runs long multi-step tasks — building three-statement models, DCFs, and presentation decks — grounded in a firm's internal data, public disclosures, and trusted financial sources, with custom LLMs tuned for financial documents. It is deployed at investment banks, private-equity firms, and hedge funds, with SOC 2 and ISO 27001 compliance and zero-data-retention agreements with model providers.

modelSupport.notes: Combines OpenAI frontier models with custom LLMs built for financial documents.

edge: Works natively inside Excel itself, building auditable three-statement models and DCFs in the grid where finance teams already work.

references.title: Building an autonomous financial analyst with o1 and o3-mini
